data.name: Logix network hub/repeater

specification.media_access_control: One receiver-credit-aware transmit grant at a time; common-rate streaming repetition, with coordinated discovery, qualification and fallback.
specification.rate_scope: One common rate across all admitted stations; one transmitter at a time. Port count does not multiply shared bandwidth. Application throughput is lower and remains unvalidated.

introduced.event_name: NCC 1981 — Logix networking / Artemis PRO launch

manufacturing_requirements: Qualify 4-, 8- and 16-port SKUs with a shared selectable clock, negotiation/recovery firmware and receiver-credit-aware arbiter. Forward by streaming at one common rate; no per-port rate conversion. Separate per-port connector/transceiver/protection costs from shared logic/PSU. Qualify cables, fault isolation and diagnostics at 100/250/500/1000 kbit/s. Port count does not multiply the maximum 1 Mbit/s shared raw capacity.
